scaleBeatText: A person, maybe 30s walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
📺 The billing says EXTREME RISK — almost nobody walks away from this one.
Almost nobody walks away from this one.
👂 Overheard — Olivia (to Yuhang): "Karl's story has a fresh coat of paint." Olivia taps the table. "Scrape it off and you get a plumber. Just don't scrape it in front of them."

With Haven grieving, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Emberhold's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.
🚶 Haven walks from the table cleanly — no blades, no hard words. The bond ends where it stood, honestly.

With Haven grieving, The Red Table II installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

🗣️ Ailbe to Svetlana, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

📯 The Red Table II's court summons Haven's speaker. SWEAR the oath of the realm (a gift seals it), SERVE at their court (seven days of your speaker's life), or WALK — break the link and stay a free fire, refusing the scale itself with it (the offer does not return). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.

◈ SYSTEM: "37. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."
📡 Haven feasts for the cameras — 5,165 kcal of theater, every fire of the realm at the table. The chat eats it up. Somewhere, the table makes a note.
◈ SYSTEM: "Species agency: unlocked. You are not at the table yet. But the table has your name now."
📺 CONTEST: The Long Odds. Dice against the house champion — a smug alien who has never lost on camera. The dice are fair. The stakes are the game. Raise, hold, or walk — but the table is unavoidable.

📺 The last roll. Everything staked is in the middle of the table, and the dice are in your hand.

OVERTIME ×6! MAXIMUM OVERTIME! The table is still set. The chair is getting cold. Sit — or don't! We LOVE this!
